title: Live state under return embedding
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number and let $c$ be a configuration of a $k$-work-tape machine. If $c$ has a state, then embedding its state into the left summand of the disjoint union of its state set with a singleton gives the same configuration as renaming its state by the left-summand injection.
hypotheses_covered: The state of $c$ is not absent
